# Bonatto

> Software Engineer writing about programming languages, systems, type theory, and other technical subjects.

This site contains static HTML pages with the complete text of each post.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://fibonatto.github.io/): Full-text static version of the blog.
- [RSS](https://fibonatto.github.io/rss.xml): RSS feed for new posts.

## Posts

- [A Life Offline](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/a_life_offline.html): I grew up with computers as an escape from life. Now, after years of dial-up, LAN parties, forums, games, and social media, I find myself wanting to escape from the internet instead. Maybe there is still a life worth living offline.

- [Proverbs 1](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/proverbs1.html): The Father who teaches before the mistake

- [The Speed of Light and the Illusion of Infinite Intelligence](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/ORDO.html): Why bigger models alone won't solve the problems of AI reliability, and why we need better architecture instead.

- [Context as a Risk Variable](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/context_as_a_risk_variable.html): A mathematical formulation for why more context does not imply more reliability in systems with LLMs

- [Your Terminal Can Be Much More Productive, Beautiful, and User-Friendly!](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/terminal.html): Still using a heavy framework or a stock shell? You're leaving performance on the table. Learn how to evolve your workflow to a professional-grade setup using Antidote, custom Zsh logic, and high-performance tools.

- [Agorism](https://fibonatto.github.io/post/agorism.html): A brief introduction to agorism, the political philosophy I identify with.
